---
title: "Provenance"
---

Where every input came from and how every result was produced. The values
live in machine-readable files; this page says where, and does not repeat
them.

## Data sources and outputs

`provenance.yml` is the single record. It lists each file in
`data/external/` under `sources`, with its origin, version or access date,
licence and SHA-256 checksum, and each output the paper uses under
`outputs`, with the code that produces it and the inputs it reads.
`just verify` fails if a file in `data/external/` is unrecorded or no longer
matches its checksum.

## Protocol

`protocol/manifest.toml` lists the frozen protocol files. `protocol/lock.json`,
written only by `just freeze-protocol`, records when they were frozen, the
commit and their SHA-256 hashes. Changes after the freeze are recorded in
`docs/amendments/`.

## Software environment

`uv.lock` pins the Python environment and `.python-version` the Python
version. The versions of uv, just and Quarto used for verification are
pinned in `.github/workflows/check.yml`.
